name: Octopost
description: Octopost is a remote MCP server for posting to X, Bluesky, Mastodon and LinkedIn. An agent posts, schedules and threads, drips posts out from a queue, and holds any post a person should check in an approval queue (agents cannot approve their own posts). OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, or an API key as a Bearer header. Paid plans from $29/month with a 7-day trial for $1.
author: Great Work LLC
